dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: I remember seeing it just behind the Central Hub...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: ...So how come you didn't bring it back when you first saw it?

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: I'd have been more than happy to, if this one component was enough to fix the whole domain.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: But with three other components to find... I suddenly felt overwhelmed by how much work needed doing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon kinda gets that... Taking the first step is always the hardest part.
